project_type: Full-stack RAG application: Python FastAPI backend + React frontend + Cloudflare Workers edge layer
build_system: pnpm monorepo with corepack, pip-compile for Python. Backend builds via Dockerfile.
test_framework: pytest with pytest-asyncio for backend, vitest for edge/frontend
build_command: pnpm install && pnpm --filter syrabit-edge exec tsc --noEmit (edge type check), ruff check apps/backend/app/ (backend lint)
verification_instructions: 1. Run ruff check on backend, 2. Run pytest for backend, 3. Run pnpm edge typecheck and tests, 4. Verify branch is ahead of main with all changes
setup_instructions: Python 3.11 via pyenv, Node 22 via nvm, corepack enable, pnpm install, pip install deps
environment_constraints: OPEN_INTERNET - full network access available. Docker available for container builds.
contribution_requirements: All CI workflows use --frozen-lockfile (this is part of CICD-02 fix). Tests must pass. Lint must pass.
key_patterns: Backend uses FastAPI routers in apps/backend/app/api/v1/. jose jwt for tokens (being migrated to PyJWT). Upstash Redis for rate limiting/caching. Azure Search for RAG. Edge uses Cloudflare Workers with vitest. Frontend uses React with context pattern.
